description: Official executive, regulatory, electoral, and parliamentary records, plus the lobbying feature's transparency registers and meeting declarations (declarations as filed; no influence claim) and the elections feature's official result files (figures as published; preliminary and certified kept apart), and the legislation features' US Congress and UK Parliament bills, text versions, actions and stages, sponsors, roll calls and divisions and Hansard references (as published; no passage prediction, member scoring or legal-effect summary).
